svg.title: The clock that would not change
svg.desc: Anime-style view of a video meeting with captions on. Pinky is sharing his screen: a Date and Time dialog whose Change buttons are greyed out, alongside a license-expired warning. Brain keeps telling him to click again; Victim 1 and Victim 2 watch in silence.

g.text: Services are stopped. Contact your vendor to renew the license.

It’s greyed out. I don’t have rights.
